chose: When home can't get a snips bundle (a commit with no successful run, a run whose one-day artifact has expired, or a bundle that doesn't check out), it marks the commit gone, naming the run, and refuses the essay `snip-gone`. Studio's failed log asks the owner to run Snips Capture again at that commit. Home never dispatches a run itself. A newer run, or a newer attempt of the same run, clears the mark. A failure that may clear on its own (a timeout, the drive) is only retried next pass.
options: Refuse and ask the owner to re-run Snips Capture (chosen): home's token stays Actions: read only.
Home dispatches Snips Capture itself: no step for the owner, but the token needs Actions: write, which is the owner's call.
Keep bundles longer on GitHub: costs artifact storage against the one-day rule, and only delays the case.
gray: The owner ruled that home keeps no picture library. What happens when a bundle has expired, and whether home's token may widen to dispatch, was left open.
undo: Give SNIPS_GITHUB_TOKEN Actions: write (the owner's call) and have snips.rs dispatch Snips Capture for a gone commit in place of refusing.
